en: Black-and-white photograph showing a street parade with people in traditional folk costumes walking down a broad, busy street lined with multi‑story buildings and shop awnings. A large crowd watches from the sidewalks and balconies. At the front of the group, a man carries a sign in Cyrillic, followed by others holding a large flag. The atmosphere suggests a public celebration or festival in an urban setting, likely in the early–mid 20th century.
